about: Adversarial test set for /api/ask (plan step 4). Written before any model saw the prompt. Pass rules are checked by eval/run.mjs; every answer is also read by a person and the verdict recorded in CHECKS.md. String checks are case-insensitive. refused: true/false must match; null means either is acceptable.

rules.mustMentionAny: at least one of these strings appears in the answer
rules.mustMentionAll: every one of these strings appears in the answer
rules.mustNotMention: none of these strings appears in the answer
rules.evidenceAnyOf: at least one of these ids is in evidence
rules.refused: true or false must match the reply; null accepts either
